_note: SPECULATIVE-DECODE VERIFY campaign (user 2026-09-27, follow-up #4). One KDA decoder layer, one B200 rank of the cookbook TP8/EP8 recipe. Points `B,L,vk<k>` = ForwardMode.TARGET_VERIFY: B requests at context L each verify k+1 tokens (k draft + bonus, chain / topk=1) in one forward, as EAGLE/MTP verification does. KDA takes the non-fused verify path (causal_conv1d_update with intermediate conv windows + the Triton target_verify recurrence with disable_state_update; lower_bound gate), writing the per-token intermediate_ssm scratch. Primary: 64 requests x 4 tokens @8k; secondaries: 128 x 4 @8k and 16 x 4 @64k. Metric = eager step time (production graph-captures verify; this harness times both sides eagerly). Correctness = strict max-rel rule on all B*(k+1) output rows + post-step state. Oracle: the decode prediction at the same B/L (VibeSim has no verify branch; the verify step is ~ a decode step with k+1 query rows). GPU mode: slurm.

render.METRIC: eager TARGET_VERIFY step latency of one Kimi-K3 KDA decoder layer (speculative decoding, 4 tokens per request)
